features_delivered: True concurrency overlap (10 workers): synchronized thread barrier coordinates exactly 10 worker threads leasing and executing distinct slots simultaneously; measured by sweep-line algorithm (measure_overlapping_tasks) with observed_peak >= 10

Provider rate limit caps (max 5): 10 concurrent worker threads making external AI/OCR calls are strictly constrained to <= 5 simultaneous active allocations via ProviderConcurrencyConfig and ProviderSemaphoreLease

Lease expiry and resilient worker recovery: crashed worker tasks (expired lease_until) are reclaimed by recovery workers with incremented attempt numbers and new lease tokens, while zombie worker commits with stale tokens are rejected with LeaseLostError
Duplicate job deduplication: idempotent phase wave re-dispatching returns existing 10 jobs without duplicate database rows or constraint violations

Ingestion prompt injection neutralization: untrusted source text containing instruction overrides, system extractions, boundary breakouts, and hidden unicode control characters are sanitized and neutralized

Source rights revocation publication gate: revoked historical sources (rights_status='revoked' or public_display_allowed=False) immediately fail closed in CDN distribution policy (AssetRightsRevokedError) and domain governance

Negative abuse invariant: observed_peak exact; '10 concurrent' label is strictly rejected when measured peak is < 10 (e.g. 9 or 1), verified via validate_concurrency_invariant and ConcurrencyMeasurementError
State machine and cancellation safety: canceled runs revoke active leases and block subsequent phase wave dispatches with InvalidPhaseStateError
Persistence resilience: research runs, phases, jobs, attempts, and evidence records survive session close and database reconnections without data loss
